timeline.body:
Closes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/99749

Adds explicit tests on text_expansion query to ensure it is compatible with both `sparse_vector` and `rank_features` field types.
Add duplicate tests for `rank_features` and `sparse_vector` field types
Duplicates the existing YAML tests for adding `rank_features` and `sparse_vector` field types.
This was only available since 8.something. I think you need to ensure you skip older versions.
